# Fonts

The WOFF2 files supply Nunito to the web guide. Nunito-Regular.ttf and Nunito-Bold.ttf are static 400/700-weight instances of nunito-latin-wght-normal.woff2 for the XeLaTeX PDF; generated with fontTools 4.68.0 (instantiateVariableFont, updateFontNames=True). They use the same OFL.txt license. The PDF build consumes the committed TTFs and does not require fontTools.
